note: Runs `manage.py runserver` (threaded), not `invoke apiserver`, whose `--nothreading` stalls under Django 2.2 (RDM-osf.io-dev2027 PR #13): since 2.2 the development server keeps a connection open for the next request, a single-threaded server then waits on it, and a browser that opens an idle second connection blocked every other client for 30 s until the socket timed out (measured in the first run on the integration candidate: Playwright's API calls timed out at 30 s while the ember app was open). DEBUG_MODE stays True (api_local.py), so api/base/wsgi.py does not monkey-patch gevent and each thread opens its own database connection. stdin_open: invoke's stdin-forwarding thread needs an open stdin or the process dies with `Not a tty` (real install run 9; upstream compose sets the same). tmpfs /code/website/static/built: init_app rewrites built/nodeCategories.json at every start (the image keeps only .gitkeep and that file there), which a read-only root refused in real install run 10. tmpfs /code/logs: scripts/utils.py add_file_logger writes a per-run log file there (real install run 13: register_oauth_scopes failed on the read-only root).
